reason: No proxies and mandatory maximum without voluntary shortfall, no cost/prerequisite waiver and no waiver of obligation to complete Eyrie Decree actions. Literal question asks whether shortage waives obligations; direct no-waiver ruling resolves that rather than requiring an unasked restatement of Turmoil procedure.

question.question: If instructed to place more pieces than remain, can you use proxies or choose to place fewer than available, and does shortage waive costs or Eyrie obligations?

expected.expected_answer: No proxies; pieces finite. Must place maximum possible, not choose fewer. Costs/prerequisites not waived; required Decree action still must fully complete or turmoil.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle (finite pieces and prompted placements)
source_passages.quotation: Pieces are finite: no proxies. When an instruction cannot place/take/remove all prompted pieces, **you must do the maximum possible and cannot voluntarily do fewer**; this never waives costs or prerequisites, nor the Eyrie's obligation to complete Decree actions. For simultaneous removal, remove all pieces before triggering removal effects. (1.5, G.20, G.24.)

answer.ruling: Pieces are finite and proxies cannot be used. If an instruction calls for more pieces than can be placed, taken, or removed, do the maximum possible; you may not voluntarily do less.
